# PrimeNG Templates

Highly customizable application templates to get started in no time with style. Designed and implemented by PrimeTek. Each template is a separate product with its own live preview site (and, except Sakai, a commercial license purchased via PrimeStore / primefaces.org).

> **Note:** This is a visual gallery page — each card is a logo image linking to a live preview. There is no long-form prose per template on primeng.org; the substance lives on each template's own preview site (linked below). The per-template subdirectories in the repo contain only logo/separator Angular components, no documentation.
